name: 雨中 · 透衫回眸（擦边）
description: 雨夜街头，甩发回眸；纯淋雨不带伞（避免第二个伞）
pose_tags: standing, hair flip, looking back, wet hair, shirt clinging to body, drenched clothes, rain on skin
pose_nl: the rain has soaked her oversized shirt through so it clings to her body. she looks back over her shoulder as she flips her wet hair. puddles mirror the street light.
